name: BreakoutADA Website Accessibility
author: breakoutplugins

sections.description:
The most cost-effective way to include a fully automated web accessibility solution to your existing website.
Protect your website from lawsuits and increase your potential audience.

FREE Registration & Activation. We offer a FREE 30-day trial to evaluate our service on your website. Register at https://breakoutinternetmedia.com/website-ada-accessibility/ to activate free 30-day trial.

BreakoutADA Website ADA Accessibility Plugin requires subscription to work on your website after 30 days. Subscribe at https://breakoutinternetmedia.com/website-ada-accessibility/ to activate ADA accessibility on your website.
